candidateInventoryVerification.method: Repository-native reconstruction and page export executed in GitHub Actions; canonical inventory verification succeeded before page export.

triagePolicy: This is a non-authoritative engineering triage based on canonical candidate raw OCR, geometry flags, existing selected articles, and page-level OCR context. Bucket membership MUST NOT be copied into final reconciliation without direct facsimile collation.
observedEngineeringRisks: The opening of p.145 includes the material continuation of ALC1737-art-001045 and must not be counted as a new article start.
Several canonical candidate records begin on continuation lines or absorb more than one apparent lexical unit in raw OCR.
The Internet Archive linear OCR interleaves the two printed columns and is not an authority for final column-local ordering.
Historical typography and OCR damage are severe enough that guide words or Cahita forms in complex candidates must be collated visually before promotion.
